title: Lock check
author: Iced-Cream
description: The smallest user of core-ar2's lockable parameters (core 0.8): three lockable sound fields, LOCK CHECK A, B and C (0..1000, a value above 127); A and C are also LFO destinations and appear at the end of every sound's LFO destination list, B is not. A bar along the bottom of the screen shows the offset track 1's LFO gives A or C, from the middle. A LOCK CHECK page behind the LFO key shows A on knob A and C on knob B, for track 1's sound, so RANDOMIZE PAGE and RELOAD PAGE can be tried on it, and with a trig held its p-lock, which a second bar shows while the trig plays. From 1.6 a fourth field, D, an LFO destination whose short name, name and category are longer than core shows, to check core's cut; and two more bars for C: its value as the active scene and the performances leave it, and the lock of the trig track 1 plays. From 1.7 (core 0.9) B is declared "smooth": false, and every audio block it records core_param_value of A, B and C on track 1 with the targets of A and C in a ring of 512 blocks (lc_ring, after the magic SMCK), with what the three calls cost in DMA timer 0's ticks, for the emulator's checks of the smoothed value.
